name: How are costs determined for interior home repairs?

mainEntity.name: How are costs determined for interior home repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of interior damage repair depends on the square footage involved, the depth of material damage, and the trades required. A simple drywall patch and paint blend costs substantially less than rebuilding a water-damaged bathroom ceiling that requires custom framing, moisture-resistant drywall, and sub-trade plumbing repairs. Material choices also drive costs; replacing standard baseboards differs from custom finish carpentry, tile, or marble work. A clear estimate breaks down demolition, framing, drywall hanging, taping, texture matching, and painting so you see the complete scope before work begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on the damage size, whether underlying framing or plumbing needs attention, and the specific materials needed for drywall, trim, and painting.
